payments.title: Payments
payments.newPaymentDescription: Pay a farmer for a purchase that's still owed.
payments.emptyDescription: Record a payment against a purchase to see it here.
payments.deleteDescription: The payment of {{amount}} will be voided: it stays on record, marked voided, and its amount is owed again on the purchase. A cash payment goes back into the till it came from, which must still be open.
payments.cashTillRequired: Open a cash session before recording a cash payment.
payments.cashTillPermissionRequired: You need cash-session access to record a cash payment.
payments.amountPaidNowHint: Total owed: {{amount}}. You can pay in full or part.
payments.allPaidUp: Every purchase is already fully paid. Nothing to record.

till.title: Till
till.description: Your cash till: the float you start with, every provision added, and all cash paid out.
till.openDescription: Count the cash you start with. Cash payments, expenses and salaries come out of this till.
till.provisionDescription: Record cash added to your till. Each provision is kept in the till's history.
till.closeDescription: Count the cash in the till. Any difference with the expected amount is recorded as a variance.
till.openingFloatHint: The cash physically in the till now. It can be 0.
till.declaredClosingHint: The cash physically in the till at closing.
till.closedDescription: Open your till with the float you start with to record cash payments and provisions.
till.closedNoPermission: You don't have permission to open a till. Ask your manager.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Running costs paid from the till: vehicle parts, fuel, office supplies and the like.
expenses.emptyDescription: Expenses recorded from the till appear here, newest first.

form.title: Record an expense
form.description: Paid in cash from the open till. The till goes down by this amount.
form.tillRequired: Expenses are paid from the till: open the till first.
form.whatHint: e.g. Brake pads for the Hilux, 2 reams of paper
form.whatRequired: Say what the money was spent on.
form.paidToHint: The shop, garage or person who received the cash (optional).

cancel.title: Cancel this expense?
cancel.description: {{amount}} for “{{what}}” goes back into the till it was paid from. The expense stays in the list, marked cancelled.
